Privacy policy

Last updated: 2026-11-20

This page explains what personal data is collected when you visit this website or buy from Walter Works, who collects it, and what happens to it. We keep it short because we collect very little.

Who we are

This website and its products are run by Walter Works.

Walter Works is run by Thomas Shear, based in the United States, who is responsible for your data.

To ask about your data, use the details on our contact page.

Visiting this website

This website is a set of plain pages. It:

  • sets no cookies and uses no browser storage;
  • runs no analytics, tracking pixels or advertising scripts;
  • uses JavaScript in one place only: on product pages, a few lines copy any campaign tags (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term) from the address you arrived with onto the Buy link, so Polar's checkout can show us which link or post sent a sale. It stores nothing on your device and sends nothing to us; the tags only travel if you click Buy;
  • has no forms, comments, accounts or sign-ups;
  • loads nothing from other companies' servers (no web fonts, embedded videos or social media widgets).

So we do not collect any personal data from you when you browse the site.

Hosting

The site is hosted by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). Like most web hosts, GitHub may record technical information about requests to the site, such as your IP address, for security and to keep the service running. GitHub handles that data under the GitHub Privacy Statement. We do not receive visitor logs or statistics from GitHub.

Buying a product

Purchases are processed by Polar (polar.sh), which acts as the merchant of record. That means Polar is the seller in the transaction: it runs the checkout, takes payment, calculates and collects any sales tax or VAT, and sends your receipt and download link.

  • You enter your payment and billing details on Polar's checkout, not on this website. We never see or store your full card details.
  • Polar uses your data under its own privacy policy and buyer terms, which are linked from its checkout. Please read them there.
  • Polar shares with us the order details we need to deliver the product and help you. This includes your name, email address, billing country and what you bought.

We use those order details only to:

  • deliver your product and answer your questions;
  • process refunds (see our refund policy);
  • keep the business and tax records the law requires.

We do not sell or rent your data. We do not add you to a mailing list because you bought something. We have no mailing list today. If we start one, joining will be a separate opt-in, and this policy will be updated first.

Emailing us

If you email us, we receive your email address and whatever you write. We use it only to reply and to deal with your request.

How long we keep data

We keep order records for as long as tax and accounting rules require. We keep support emails for as long as we need them to deal with your request, or to handle a follow-up about the same order.

Your choices and rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to ask for a copy of your personal data, or to have it corrected or deleted. Contact us through the contact page and we will help. We may need to keep some records where the law requires it, for example for tax. For data that Polar holds as the seller, you can also contact Polar directly.

Changes to this policy

If we change how we handle data, for example by adding a newsletter or analytics, we will update this page before the change goes live and change the date at the top.
